runtime_strategy: 2D deterministic presentation built from pre-baked renders of the actual 3D models; no live SubViewport required
integration_seam: current match start path after validation/stage/fighter setup, before existing _begin_ready()
supported_initial_case: exactly two active supported roster fighters

fallbacks.unsupported_fighter: bypass VS and preserve existing _begin_ready path
fallbacks.not_exactly_two_active_fighters: bypass VS and preserve existing path
fallbacks.missing_echo: use primary at opacity 0.18 + grayscale/tint as emergency fallback only; log warning
fallbacks.mephisto: supported visually but keep provisional status; do not treat as quality gate

main_gd_change_limit: minimal orchestration only; do not redesign setup/frontend/gameplay
